modules.title: Roles and privileges
goals: Operate PostgreSQL roles and privileges with explicit, reviewable SQL.
Prefer core PostgreSQL mechanisms before adding external operational burden.
Connect administrative choices to application safety, portability, and recovery.
exit_competencies: Diagnose common roles and privileges incidents from catalog evidence.
Write least-privilege or least-surprise remediation plans.
Explain the operational tradeoff without relying on superuser shortcuts.
